shared: Mature 2D editorial art for Tomorrow and Tomorrow discovery cards. Each direction uses its own visible handmade medium and limited palette. Keep the discovery's action or mechanism legible in a central 3:2 crop and match its historical stage. Reject photographic rendering, volumetric digital painting, CGI, cinematic lighting, cute faces, child-book proportions, pseudo-writing, emblems, borders, and watermarks. Art medium describes rendering, never an object placed in the historical scene.
